tree.text: My Favorite Way to Have Fun

children.cn: 引出话题与最喜欢的休闲活动

children.text: As the saying goes, "All work and no play makes Jack a dull boy."
children.cn: 常言道：“只工作不玩耍，聪明孩子也变傻。”
children.notes: As the saying goes: 常言道，正如谚语所说; all work and no play makes Jack a dull boy: 只工作不玩耍，聪明孩子也变傻
children.statement: 本句运用了题目给出的经典名言谚语引出话题，增强文章表现力。
children.explanation: 开篇引用谚语，切题且富有文采。

children.text: After busy study, relaxing is very important.
children.cn: 在繁忙的学习之余，放松是非常重要的。
children.notes: busy study: 繁忙的学习; relaxing: 放松（动名词作主语）; important: 重要的
children.statement: 句中 relaxing 为动名词短语作主语，谓语动词用单数 is。
children.explanation: 动名词作主语，符合标准英语语法规范。

children.text: My favorite way to have fun is playing badminton.
children.cn: 我最喜欢的娱乐方式是打羽毛球。
children.notes: favorite way to do sth: 做某事最喜欢的方式; have fun: 玩得开心，娱乐; play badminton: 打羽毛球
children.statement: 本句直接回应了提纲要点1“你最喜欢的休闲活动是什么”。
children.explanation: 明确点明最喜欢的休闲活动是打羽毛球。

children.cn: 开展活动的方式与细节

children.text: I usually play badminton with my best friends on the sports field after school or on weekends.
children.cn: 放学后或周末，我通常和最好的朋友在运动场上打羽毛球。
children.notes: with my best friends: 和我最好的朋友; on the sports field: 在运动场上; on weekends: 在周末
children.statement: 本句通过交代伙伴、地点和时间，详细回答了要点2“通常如何开展该活动”。
children.explanation: 包含与谁做、在哪做、何时做的具体要素。

children.text: Playing badminton not only helps me build a strong body and keep fit, but also makes me feel energetic and happy.
children.cn: 打羽毛球不仅帮助我强身健体、保持健康，还让我感到充满活力和快乐。
children.notes: not only... but also...: 不仅……而且……; build a strong body: 强身健体; keep fit: 保持健康; energetic: 精力充沛的
children.statement: 本句运用了 not only... but also... 连接并列分句，丰富句式结构。
children.explanation: 连词短语 not only... but also... 能够流畅并列生理与心理的双重收获。
children.keywords: not only, but also, keep fit, energetic

children.text: It is a wonderful way to relax.
children.cn: 这真是一种极佳的放松方式。
children.notes: a wonderful way to do sth: 做某事的极好方式; relax: 放松
children.statement: 本句作为全文总结句，简洁有力地照应了文章主题。
children.explanation: 首尾呼应，篇章结构严谨。

tree.text: My Favorite Way to Have Fun
tree.cn: 我最喜欢的娱乐方式 (进阶版)

children.text: As an old saying goes, "All work and no play makes Jack a dull boy."
children.cn: 正如一句古老谚语所说：“只工作不玩耍，聪明孩子也变傻。”
children.notes: As an old saying goes: 正如一句古谚所说; dull: 迟钝的，呆滞的
children.statement: 以经典的英文谚语开篇，直接点出劳逸结合的必要性。
children.explanation: 进阶版引言自然地为下文展开休闲娱乐做铺垫。

children.text: After busy study, taking part in relaxing activities is necessary.
children.cn: 在繁忙的学习之后，参加放松活动是非常必要的。
children.notes: take part in: 参加; relaxing activities: 放松身心的活动; necessary: 必要的
children.statement: 动名词短语 taking part in... 作为主语，体现高阶句式表达。
children.explanation: 用 taking part in 替代简单的 relaxing，用词更丰富精确。

children.text: Among all kinds of leisure activities, my favorite way to have fun is playing badminton.
children.cn: 在各种各样的休闲活动中，我最喜欢的娱乐方式是打羽毛球。
children.notes: among all kinds of: 在所有各种各样之中; leisure activities: 休闲活动
children.statement: 介词短语 Among all kinds of leisure activities 放在句首作为范围状语，使表达更具书面语色彩。
children.explanation: 范围状语前置，使主题陈述更加引人注目。
children.highlight: Among all kinds of leisure activities

children.cn: 具体开展方式与日常习惯

children.text: I usually practice it with my best friends on the school playground every Friday afternoon.
children.cn: 我通常在每周五下午和最要好的朋友在学校操场上练习它。
children.notes: practice: 练习; playground: 操场; every Friday afternoon: 每周五下午
children.statement: 本句运用 practice 代替单一的 play，时间状语精确到 every Friday afternoon，细节饱满。
children.explanation: 用词多样化且细节生动准确。

children.cn: 全方位收获与内心感受

children.text: Playing badminton not only builds up my strength and helps me keep fit, but also relieves my academic stress and strengthens our friendship.
children.cn: 打羽毛球不仅增强我的体魄、帮助我保持健康，还能缓解我的学业压力并加深我们的友谊。
children.notes: build up one's strength: 增强体魄; relieve stress: 缓解压力; academic: 学业的; strengthen friendship: 增进友谊
children.statement: 本句多维并列了强身健体（身体）、缓解压力（心理）和加深友谊（社交）三项益处。
children.explanation: 内容维度极为丰富，使用 builds up strength, relieves stress 和 strengthens friendship 等优质搭配。
children.keywords: builds up, strength, relieves stress, strengthens friendship

children.text: It truly brings great joy and energy to my daily life.
children.cn: 它确实给我的日常生活带来了巨大的快乐与活力。
children.notes: truly: 真正地，确实; bring sth to sb/sth: 给……带来……; joy and energy: 快乐与能量
children.statement: 副词 truly 增强感情色彩，以积极向上的基调结束全篇。
children.explanation: 尾句升华主题，感情充沛真挚。
